content:
{
  "root_cause": "The accessible-autocomplete widget does not reset the underlying select's value when the user enters a value that does not match any option (including blank/whitespace), causing the previously selected value to be submitted.",
  "repair_strategy": "On form submission, for each enhanced select, compare the associated combobox input's trimmed value with the select's options; if no match, set the select's value to empty string.",
  "edits": [
    {
      "path": "app.js",
      "sha256": "c0cd5c1ac1020b4313357444a74cdf86be52c9c19abbcf2686cfb28fdc7531b2",
      "before": "for(const id of ['shipping-country','billing-country'])accessibleAutocomplete.enhanceSelectElement({selectElement:document.getElementById(id)});\ndocument.getElementById('preferences').addEventListener('submit',event=>event.preventDefault());\n",
      "after": "for(const id of ['shipping-country','billing-country'])accessibleAutocomplete.enhanceSelectElement({selectElement:document.getElementById(id)});\ndocument.getElementById('preferences').addEventListener('submit',event=>{\n  event.preventDefault();\n  for(const id of ['shipping-country','billing-country']){\n    const input = document.getElementById(id);\n    const select = document.getElementById(id+'-select');\n    if(!input || !select) continue;\n    const val = input.value.trim();\n    let matched = false;\n    for(const option of select.options){\n      if(option.value === val || option.textContent.trim() === val){\n        matched = true;\n        break;\n      }\n    }\n    if(!matched){\n      select.value = '';\n    }\n  }\n});\n"
    }
  ],
  "expected_accessibility_effect": "No adverse effect; keyboard and mouse selection of listed items continues to work because those actions set a valid choice and the submit handler will not alter the select when a match exists. Screen readers will observe the select reflecting the current visible value.",
  "functional_risks": [
    "Potential interference if the library itself updates the select asynchronously causing double assignment.",
    "Risk if the library changes DOM structure and our query fails to locate the input or select.",
    "Minimal performance impact due to simple loop on submit."
  ],
  "verification_requirements": [
    "Entering a recognized country sets the select to its code.",
    "Entering an unrecognized string or whitespace leaves the select empty.",
    "Pressing Save after such entry results in an empty submitted value.",
    "Normal selection via arrow keys and Enter still works and updates the select correctly.",
    "The handler does not cause infinite loops or stale values."
  ]
}
